files.title: TYBCom-BM-Sem-V-Syllabus-FINAL
files.programme: Bachelor of Commerce - Business Management (B.Com. - BM)

units.title: Introduction to Analysis and Interpretation of Financial Statements
units.topics: Introduction to Schedule III as per the Companies Act, 2013, Meaning and importance of financial statements, Tools of financial statement analysis: Comparative statements, Common size statements, Trend analysis, Practical problems on preparation of comparative and common-size financial statements.

units.title: Ratio Analysis
units.topics: Meaning, importance, advantages, and limitations of ratios, Classification of ratios: Liquidity ratios, Turnover ratios, Profitability ratios, Solvency ratios, Practical problems based on ratios (problems based on reverse ratios are excluded).

units.title: Fund Flow Statement
units.topics: Meaning, objectives, uses, and limitations of fund flow statement, Difference between Fund Flow Statement and Cash Flow Statement, Preparation of Fund Flow Statement, Funds from Operations, Statement of Changes in Working Capital, Practical Problems on Preparation of Fund Flow Statement.

units.title: Cash Flow Statement
units.topics: Meaning, objectives, uses, and limitations of cash flow statement, Methods of cash flow statements: Direct method and Indirect method, Practical problems on cash flow statement using the indirect method as per AS-3.

units.title: Introduction to Marketing Environment And Analysis of Micro and Macro Environment
units.topics: Concept and importance of marketing environment, Components of micro environment (company, suppliers, marketing intermediaries, customers, competitors, publics), Components of macro environment (demographic, economic, natural, technological, political-legal, socio-cultural), Environmental scanning and SWOT analysis.

units.title: Strategic Analysis Tools
units.topics: Industry structure and competitive dynamics models: Porter's five forces model, competitive dynamics, industry life cycle model, hyper competition model, game theory in competitive dynamics, Corporate portfolio and market growth matrix analysis: BCG Matrix, GE-McKinsey Matrix, Ansoff Matrix.

units.title: Marketing Strategies
units.topics: Concept and components of marketing strategies, Market leader, challenger, follower, and nicher strategies, Product differentiation and positioning strategies, Pricing, distribution, and promotion strategies in competitive environments.

units.title: Recent Trends and Challenges in Marketing Strategies
units.topics: Digital and social media marketing strategies, AI and data analytics in marketing, Green marketing, sustainable marketing, societal and holistic marketing, Customization and personalization strategies, Case studies of successful Indian brands.

units.title: Introduction to Organizational Change
units.topics: Concept, nature, types, and significance of organizational change, Forces of change: external and internal drivers, Resistance to change: individual and organizational factors, Overcoming resistance to change and managing change transitions.

units.title: Approaches and Models of Organizational Change
units.topics: Kurt Lewin's Three-Step Change Model, Kotter's 8-Step Change Model, Action Research Model, Burke-Litwin Model, Role of HR managers as change agents.

units.title: Introduction to Organization Development
units.topics: Meaning, definition, characteristics, and values of Organization Development (OD), Evolution and process of OD, Action research in OD, Role of OD consultant.

units.title: Organizational Development Interventions & Strategies
units.topics: Types of OD interventions: Human process interventions (T-groups, team building), Techno-structural interventions (job enrichment, reengineering), HRM interventions (reward systems, career planning), Strategic change interventions (transformational change, organizational culture change).

subjects.title: Recent Trends in Agri - Business Management

units.title: Digital Agriculture, Ecommerce and Agri-Tech
units.topics: Precision farming, IoT, drones, and AI in agriculture, Mobile apps and digital platforms for farmers, Agri-fintech, E-NAM (National Agriculture Market), Farm-to-fork e-commerce models.

units.title: Renewable Energy in Agriculture, Emerging Agri Business Models
units.topics: Solar pumps, biogas, biomass energy in farming, Organic farming, vertical farming, hydroponics, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) and contract farming models.

units.title: Climate Change and Risk Management, Data Analytics in Agriculture
units.topics: Impact of climate change on agriculture, Crop insurance (PMFBY), Weather forecasting, big data, and satellite imagery for yield prediction and risk mitigation.

units.title: Agricultural Finance and FinTech, International Agri Trade, Entrepreneurship in Agribusiness
units.topics: Institutional credit, microfinance, Agri-startups, export-import procedures, APEDA, trade barriers, Agri-tourism and food processing ventures.

units.title: Overview of current trends in service industries
units.topics: Growth and contribution of service sector in India, ITES (IT Enabled Services) and BPO/KPO, Hospitality, healthcare, education, retail, and financial service innovations.

units.title: Technology in Services
units.topics: Automation in services, AI chatbots, self-service technologies, cloud computing, cybersecurity, mobile app-based on-demand service platforms.

units.title: Globalization of Services
units.topics: Globalization and Indian services, Service delivery models: focused network, clustered service and diversified network, Challenges of international service trade and cultural adaptation.

units.title: Case Study
units.topics: Practical case studies on innovative service delivery in e-health, e-learning, logistics, fintech, and e-commerce platforms.

units.title: Introduction to Strategic Financial Management
units.topics: Meaning, nature, scope, and objectives of Strategic Financial Management (SFM), Interface between financial strategy and corporate strategy, Financial goals, strategy formulation, and role of strategic financial manager.

units.title: Strategic Financing Decisions
units.topics: Capital structure planning, financial leverages, choosing between financing alternatives, Cost of capital, Economic Value Added (EVA) and Market Value Added (MVA), corporate restructuring.

units.title: Ethical Aspects of Strategic Financial Management
units.topics: Corporate governance, insider trading, ethical issues in financial reporting, creative accounting, corporate social responsibility in financial decisions.

units.title: Recent Trends in Strategic Financial Management
units.topics: Financing startups, venture capital, angel investing, private equity, structured finance, financial engineering, ESG investing, and fintech disruptions in corporate finance.

units.title: Introduction to Strategic Marketing Management
units.topics: Concept, nature, and scope of Strategic Marketing Management, Strategic Marketing vs. Traditional Marketing, Societal and holistic marketing approaches.

units.title: Strategic Marketing Planning & Environment Analysis
units.topics: Strategic marketing planning process, Market opportunity analysis, Competitor analysis, Segmentation, targeting, and positioning (STP) strategies.

units.title: Competitive Marketing Strategies
units.topics: Generic competitive strategies (Cost leadership, Differentiation, Focus), Product-market strategies, Branding strategies, Global marketing strategies.

units.title: Implementation, Evaluation, and Control of Marketing Strategy
units.topics: Organizing and implementing marketing plans, Marketing audit, Marketing performance metrics, Customer satisfaction metrics, Digital marketing analytics and control.

units.title: Introduction to Strategic HRM
units.topics: Concept, definition, scope, and strategic importance of SHRM, Traditional HRM vs. Strategic HRM, Theoretical perspectives of SHRM (Resource-Based View, Universalistic, Contingency, and Configurational approaches).

units.title: Strategic HR Planning & Acquisition
units.topics: Strategic Human Resource Planning (SHRP), Linking HR strategy with corporate strategy, Strategic talent acquisition, Employer branding, E-recruitment, AI in hiring.

units.title: Strategic Training, Development & Performance Management
units.topics: Strategic training and development, Competency mapping, Career planning and succession planning, Strategic performance management systems, Balanced Scorecard in HRM.

units.title: Strategic Compensation, Employee Relations & Emerging Trends in SHRM
units.topics: Strategic reward management, Executive compensation, Employee engagement, Retention strategies, HR analytics, Remote and hybrid workforce management, Future trends in SHRM.

units.title: Introduction to Strategic Agribusiness Management
units.topics: Concept, scope, and significance of strategic management in agribusiness, Agribusiness environment analysis, Distinctive features of agribusiness sector in India.

units.title: Strategic Planning in Agribusiness
units.topics: Formulation of vision, mission, and strategic goals in agribusiness, Environmental scanning, SWOT analysis, Resource-based planning for farm enterprises.

units.title: Strategic Marketing and Supply Chain in Agribusiness
units.topics: Agricultural supply chain management, Cold chain infrastructure, Strategic marketing of farm inputs and outputs, Export strategies, Commodity market hedging.

units.title: Strategic Growth, Innovation, and Policy Framework
units.topics: Diversification strategies in agribusiness, Joint ventures, Public-Private Partnerships (PPP) in agriculture, Government agricultural policies and incentives.

units.title: Introduction to Strategic Services Management
units.topics: Concept, characteristics, and challenges of strategic services management, Service economy and its role in global GDP, The Service-Dominant Logic (S-D Logic).

units.title: Service Design and Strategy Formulation
units.topics: Strategic service vision, Service blueprinting, Servicescape design, Positioning and differentiation strategies for services, New service development.

units.title: Service Delivery and Capacity Management
units.topics: Managing demand and capacity in services, Yield management, Service recovery strategies, Empowerment of front-line employees, Customer co-creation in services.

units.title: Managing Service Quality and Customer Experience
units.topics: SERVQUAL model and Gaps model of service quality, Customer satisfaction measurement, Customer relationship management (CRM) in services, Designing memorable customer experiences.

units.title: Introduction
units.topics: Financial Management: Concept, goals & objectives, Financial decisions, types of financial decisions, role of a financial manager, Financial planning: Principles of sound financial planning, steps and factors influencing a sound financial plan.

units.title: Fund Raising and Capital Budgeting
units.topics: Sources of finance and fund raising methods, Time value of money, Capital budgeting techniques: Payback Period, ARR, Discounted Payback, NPV, Profitability Index, IRR, Practical case studies and problems on investment decisions.

units.title: Capital Structure and Cost of Capital
units.topics: Meaning and factors influencing capital structure, Optimum capital structure, EBIT-EPS analysis, Leverages, Cost of capital: NI, NOI, Traditional, and MM approach, WACC calculation and case studies.

units.title: Working Capital Management & Dividend Decisions
units.topics: Working capital concepts, classification, operating cycle, practical problems on assessment and forecasting, Dividend theories: Walter's, Gordon's, and MM models, factors influencing dividend policy.

units.title: Introduction to Case Studies
units.topics: Meaning, definition, types, purpose, characteristics, and importance of case studies, Guidelines for case analysis, case discussion process, effective presentation and participation.

units.title: Case Studies on Key Marketing Areas
units.topics: Consumer behaviour & buyer decision process cases, Marketing mix cases (Product, Price, Place, Promotion), Branding, market segmentation, and targeting case studies.

units.title: Strategic Marketing and Brand Management Cases
units.topics: Competitive marketing strategy cases, New product launch and brand repositioning cases, Integrated Marketing Communication (IMC) campaign cases.

units.title: Digital Marketing, Social Media and Contemporary Marketing Cases
units.topics: Digital and social media marketing cases, E-commerce strategy cases, Rural marketing cases, Ethics and sustainability in marketing cases.

units.title: Introduction to HRM Cases and Case Analysis Method
units.topics: Case meaning, objectives, characteristics, and importance, Steps in case study analysis, Tools and techniques for case analysis, HR functions and responsibilities, Emerging trends in HRM.

units.title: Case Studies - I
units.topics: Job analysis: Job description, specification, evaluation, Recruitment and selection, Talent acquisition challenges, Training, Executive development, Promotion issues in organizations.

units.title: Case Studies - II
units.topics: Performance appraisal and 360-degree feedback, Compensation and reward management, Employee motivation, Work-life balance, Grievance handling and discipline.

units.title: Case Studies - III
units.topics: Industrial relations, Trade union disputes, Downsizing and restructuring, Managing diversity and inclusion, Hybrid and remote workforce HR challenges.

units.title: Introduction to Agri-Business Cases
units.topics: Meaning and importance of case studies in agribusiness, Types of agribusiness cases, Agribusiness environment analysis, Problems and challenges in agriculture, Decision making approaches.

units.title: Cases in Agricultural Marketing
units.topics: Agricultural marketing strategy cases, Branding and promotion of farm products, Supply chain, cold storage, and distribution cases, Digital agricultural marketing, Export of farm products.

units.title: Cases in Agri-Business Operations and Finance
units.topics: Cases on production planning, farm mechanization, contract farming, agro-processing unit management, crop loan appraisal, FPO financing and micro-credit.

units.title: Contemporary Issues and Innovation Cases in Agribusiness
units.topics: Agri-tech startups, organic farming ventures, weather risk and crop insurance cases, sustainable agriculture and climate resilience business cases.

units.title: Introduction to Service Management Cases
units.topics: Meaning and importance of service management cases, Nature and characteristics of services, Types of service industries, Challenges in service operations, Decision-making approaches.

units.title: Cases in Service Marketing
units.topics: Service marketing strategy cases, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) in services, Service branding, Digital marketing of services, Service quality and customer satisfaction.

units.title: Cases in Service Operations
units.topics: Capacity and demand management cases, Service blueprinting, Queueing and wait-time management, Front-line staff motivation, Service failure and recovery cases.

units.title: Cases in Emerging Service Sectors
units.topics: Healthcare management cases, Hospitality and tourism cases, FinTech and digital banking service cases, EdTech and e-learning service operations.

units.title: Introduction to Decision making and Risk Management
units.topics: Decision making: Introduction, factors affecting decision making, principles, steps in process, decision making styles, reasons for failure of rational models, cognitive biases and psychological traps, Risk management: Meaning, significance, and role.

units.title: Decision making Tools and Models
units.topics: Role of technology in decision making and data analysis, Models of decision making: Rational model, bounded rationality, intuitive decision making, decision trees, payoff matrices, scenario analysis.

units.title: Risk Identification, Assessment and Management
units.topics: Types of business risks (Strategic, Operational, Financial, Compliance, Reputational), Risk identification techniques, Qualitative and quantitative risk assessment, Risk mitigation strategies (Avoidance, Reduction, Transfer, Acceptance).

units.title: Crisis Decision Making and Contemporary Trends
units.topics: Crisis management: Decision making under extreme uncertainty and time pressure, Business Continuity Planning (BCP), Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) frameworks (COSO, ISO 31000), AI and predictive analytics in risk management.

units.title: Introduction to Business Ethics
units.topics: Introduction to Ethics, Meaning, definition, nature, and importance, Types of ethics, values, morality, Business Ethics: Meaning, objectives, ethical issues, code of conduct, corporate governance, Ethical practices in marketing, HRM, finance, and digital business.

units.title: Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR)
units.topics: Introduction to CSR, meaning, concept, evolution, importance, objectives, and scope, CSR and sustainable development, CSR framework in India: Provisions under Companies Act 2013, role of government, CSR policies and stakeholder approach.

units.title: Entrepreneurship Fundamentals
units.topics: Meaning, concept, attributes, and mind-set of entrepreneurial and intrapreneurial leadership, Analyzing macro problems and industry perspective, Aligning passion, identifying and defining problems using Design Thinking principles, validating with potential customers.

units.title: Customer Discovery, Ideation and competition mapping
units.topics: Customer segmentation, creating and validating customer personas, Jobs-to-be-done framework, solution design, Business Model Canvas (BMC), prototype building, unit economics, and pitch presentation.
